scope: Local source/provenance collection only. No builds, installs, binary execution, uploads or deployments. Engineering inventory, not legal assurance.

linux.license: GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note; additional per-file notices retained in source
linux.patches: No kernel source patches declared in pinned guest recipe.
linux.remaining: Publish/attach corresponding source, configuration/build instructions and notices with binary distribution. No kernel rebuild performed or needed merely to retrieve these materials.

busybox.license: GPL-2.0-only per pinned Nixpkgs metadata; upstream file-specific notices retained
busybox.config_recipe: defconfig plus Nixpkgs configurePhase overrides, enableStatic=true/useMusl=true via pkgsStatic; complete pinned package set retained. No additional override appears in pinned TryNix guest recipe.
busybox.uncertainty: Original .drv unavailable from cache.nixos.org. No bbconfig applet/symbol or embedded .config found; compressed payloads were inspected as data. Configuration-generation source/scripts are retained; absence of .drv or bit-identical rebuild is not itself stated by GPLv2 as a condition. Exact original generated configuration and linked-musl identity were not independently rebuilt/attested.
busybox.remaining: Include complete source archive, all applicable patches, config-generation/build scripts and GPL notices in the source offering; do not substitute vanilla BusyBox archive alone.

musl.binary: static libc portions within initramfs:/bin/busybox and /bin/reseed
musl.version: 1.2.6 inferred from pinned Nixpkgs recipe, not independently attested by binary
musl.license: MIT with additional file-specific notices described in COPYRIGHT/source
musl.auxiliary_sources: recipes/musl-extra; all five referenced files match pinned hashes; some are development headers/tools or x86_32-specific and are not proven included in these x86_64 binaries.
musl.uncertainty: Recipe implies musl1.2.6 for pkgsStatic and BusyBox output identity explicitly says musl. Exact libc object provenance within either static binary is not independently established; no link map or original derivation was recovered.
musl.remaining: Carry applicable musl copyright/permission notices. MIT does not itself require source offering or exact rebuild. Include retained musl source and patches conservatively in complete-source materials; verify version if independently stronger attestation is required.

initramfs.license: TryNix MIT for its original init/reseed/recipes; aggregated component licenses remain applicable
initramfs.matching_evidence: 405 cpio entries, exactly three regular files: bin/busybox, bin/reseed, init. init byte-identical to pinned source. Entire archive hash matches pinned upstream engine-pins.json.
initramfs.uncertainty: reseed was not recompiled for a byte comparison; static runtime correspondence is inferred from recipe.
initramfs.remaining: Package TryNix notice and aggregate component notices/source access. Preserve deterministic archive assembly recipe; no independent license is inferred merely from the cpio container.

practical_source_delivery: Prefer accompanying public package with complete corresponding source materials / equivalent source-copy access from the same designated distribution place, rather than starting a written-offer obligation. Publication/attachment itself not done by this task.
not_automatic_license_blockers: Not collecting source of every non-shipped host compiler/build dependency
outside_scope: Final public package contents and source hosting/access verification
